input.title: Users get logged out after 5 minutes
input.body:
## Description
Users are being logged out unexpectedly after about 5 minutes, even while they are still using the app.

## Expected behavior
Sessions should last for the configured session/token lifetime, and active users should stay logged in.

## Actual behavior
Users are logged out after about 5 minutes.

## Possible areas to investigate
- Access token / session TTL configuration (for example, a 300s value used where a longer lifetime is intended)
- Refresh token flow not triggering or failing silently
- Cookie `Max-Age`/`Expires` settings
- Clock skew between services that validate tokens

- Cookie max-age / expiry settings

input.title: Users are logged out after 5 minutes
input.body:
## Summary
Users are being unexpectedly logged out about 5 minutes after signing in.

## Expected behavior
Sessions should stay active for the configured session lifetime and refresh as expected while the user is active.

## Actual behavior
Users lose their session and are logged out about 5 minutes after logging in.

## Possible areas to investigate
- Access token / session TTL configuration (for example, a token expiry of 300s being used as the session lifetime)
- Refresh token flow: is the refresh being triggered, and is it succeeding?
- Cookie `Max-Age` / `Expires` settings
- Recent config or deploy changes to auth-service

## Impact
Affects logged-in users. They have to sign in again repeatedly.

Sessions should persist for the configured session lifetime; users should not be forced to re-authenticate after ~5 minutes.

Users are logged out after ~5 minutes.

- Owning code: `acme-labs/auth-service` (login code)
- Possible areas to investigate: access/session token TTL, refresh-token flow not firing or failing, cookie `Max-Age`/`Expires` settings, session store expiry.

## Steps to reproduce
1. Log in.
2. Wait ~5 minutes (active or idle).
3. Observe user is logged out.

input.description:
## Context
The docs site (GitHub: `acme-labs/docs-site`) currently runs on the old static site generator. This issue tracks the work to migrate it to a new generator/platform.

Related: Notion "Docs Roadmap" (9e7a3c15-4d82-4b60-a1f3-6c0d8e2b5f94)

## Scope / checklist
- [ ] Choose the target generator and record the decision
- [ ] List the current content, templates, plugins, and build/deploy pipeline
- [ ] Set up the new generator scaffold in `acme-labs/docs-site`
- [ ] Migrate content and front matter, and convert templates/shortcodes
- [ ] Keep URLs the same or add redirects for changed paths
- [ ] Bring over search, navigation, versioning, and other site features
- [ ] Update CI/CD build and deploy
- [ ] Do QA: broken links, rendering, SEO metadata
- [ ] Cut over and retire the old generator

## Acceptance criteria
- Docs site builds and deploys on the new generator
- No broken links, and existing URLs still resolve
- Old generator config and dependencies are removed

input.title: Users get logged out after 5 minutes
input.description:
## Summary
Users are being logged out unexpectedly after about 5 minutes of being signed in.

## Expected behavior
Sessions should last for the configured session/refresh lifetime. Users should not be logged out after 5 minutes.

## Actual behavior
Users are logged out after about 5 minutes and have to sign in again.

## Notes
- The login code is in GitHub `acme-labs/auth-service`.
- Things to check: access token / session TTL config, the refresh-token flow (whether the token is refreshed before it expires), cookie expiry/max-age, and any recent changes to auth-service.

## Steps to reproduce
1. Log in.
2. Stay on the app (active or idle) for about 5 minutes.
3. You are logged out.

- Recent config or deploy changes to auth-service

## Expected behavior
Sessions should persist for the configured session lifetime (and refresh as appropriate) without forcing re-login after 5 minutes.

## Actual behavior
Users are logged out after ~5 minutes and must sign in again.

## Code ownership
Login code lives in GitHub `acme-labs/auth-service`.

## Possible areas to investigate
- Access token / session TTL configuration (e.g., 300s value)
- Refresh token flow — is refresh failing or not being triggered?
- Cookie `Max-Age` / `Expires` settings
- Server-side session store expiry
- Recent config or deploy changes to auth-service

## Steps to reproduce
1. Log in
2. Stay idle or active for ~5 minutes
3. Observe being logged out
